Path: ③ 验证：响亮拒绝错的，放行对的 — a refusal message tells the author what to write | 缺项 | P2

## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:spec` · `area:workflow` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). Direction: the refusal prescribes the brace convention of the slot it refused, and ⛔ neither renderer's convention changes

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T13:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/spec/src/shared/expression.zod.ts` (the `TYPED_EXPRESSION_SOURCE_REQUIRED` and `TYPED_EXPRESSION_DIALECT_ONLY` `template` sentences, about `:286`–`:311`, and the `tmpl` docblock) ⇒ `domain:spec`; rationale: the published refusal text is spec's.

- **Why p2:** this is the release-fixed wrong-text exception, with its reach measured (the filer's run on `d4680d2820`). Following the refusal verbatim draws `flow-double-brace-interpolation` on the same node, and the notify renderer leaves the stray braces in place. An AI author follows a refusal literally.
- **Direction (ruled here; the two plain routes the body names):**
  - A refused notify `title` or `message` prescribes the notify convention, `'{record.name}'`.
  - A `template` slot whose renderer reads `{{var}}` (the messaging and email renderers) keeps its current sentence.
  - Where the refusing site cannot know the slot, the sentence names both conventions and says which renderers read which.
  - ⛔ **Not taken:** one brace convention for every `template` slot. That is the third route the body names, and it is a maintainer decision.
- **Pins:**
  - each prescribed spelling for a notify slot parses and draws no `flow-double-brace-interpolation` finding;
  - an email or messaging template slot's refusal still prescribes `{{…}}` (control);
  - the `tmpl` docblock says which renderers read which braces.
- **Related:** #19939 (`pm:queue`, `target:v18`) retires `{var}` in flow **assignment** slots. That is a different slot family, and nothing here touches it.
- `Clause-②: no`: refusal text only. Patch changeset.

**This amends my `6039475060` (one point; the direction stands).** Triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T16:18Z.

**The grade missed a governing text.** ADR-0032 (Accepted) Decision 3 reads "**One delimiter, `{{ }}`; single `{ }` deleted**" (`docs/adr/0032-unified-expression-layer.md`, §3).
- The shipped convention is the reverse:
  - the notify renderer resolves `{token}` only (`notify-node.ts:190`);
  - `flow-double-brace-interpolation` flags `{{ }}` on flow node values;
  - 71 of 73 in-repo templates are single-brace (the #15947 sweep).
- #15947's resolution (triage `5556793638`, PR #16416) records that the `template` dialect judges no brace grammar at parse time. So ADR-0032 D3's end state was never executed for these slots.

**What stands:** this card fixes the refusal so that an author who follows it is not refused again. The notify slots prescribe the spelling their renderer reads today (`{record.name}`). That is the 17.x-practical fix, ⛔ not an end-state ruling on braces.

**What does not:** whether ADR-0032 D3 is executed on the v18 line (template slots read `{{ }}`, with single-brace converted by an ADR-0087 entry), or amended to bless single-brace, is not triage's to settle. It touches an accepted decision. Triage files it as a decision card with its own face next round, and this card does not wait on it.

**This amends my `6042027032` (one point: what gets filed).** Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T17:13Z. ⛔ Not a claim.

I said the ADR-0032 D3 question would be filed as a decision card. It is filed as an execution card instead: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22110 (`target:v18`, p2).
- Under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉, the protocol is the baseline: code that disagrees with an accepted ADR is aligned to it, and an option that conflicts with the governing text is not a decision card.
- Since PR #22063, a notify node's `title` / `message` are `template`-typed slots, so the spec already names the dialect whose delimiter §3 fixes.
- Amending §3 to bless single-brace stays the maintainer's to ask for, on its own card.

**What stands on this card:** the 17.x refusal text prescribes the spelling the notify renderer reads today (`{record.name}`), and it does not wait on #22110. #22110 flips that prescription on the v18 line.

Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `expression.zod.ts`, the notify executor or its descriptor (open PRs' file lists read at this stamp). `area:workflow` has #22088 in flight (PR #22119, `flow.zod.ts` and the step-18 chain): file surfaces are disjoint. #22110 (`target:v18`, ADR-0032 D3) later flips this card's notify prescription on the v18 line; triage's amendment `6042955917` says this card does not wait on it.

## 🔁 REWORK (round 1): PR #22124 at `5a710d6231`. Same claim, same branch, the same dev is re-dispatched

`domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `os-justin` · session `session_01RPo7FUd6bSnAfkWMAKi848` · 2026-10-07T21:07Z · holder of claim `6044705682`, on the dev report `6046827692`.

The fix is right as read: H2 held (the refusing site knows the slot), `TemplateExpressionInputSchema`'s two sentences are byte-unchanged, the accept set of `title` / `message` is unchanged, and the `{record.name}` prescription lives in one constant. One thing is wrong, and the round carries exactly it:

1. **The PR widens `@objectstack/spec`'s public face under `Clause-②: no` and a `patch` changeset.**
   - `packages/spec/api-surface/shared.json` gains `"templateExpressionInput (const)"`, and `export-origins/shared.json` gains its origin, because `shared/index.ts` re-exports `* from './expression.zod'`. The changeset says so: "New export on `@objectstack/spec/shared`: `templateExpressionInput(…)`".
   - The claim line's test is whether the card widens the accept set **or the public face**. A new export does, and AGENTS.md has `Clause-②: yes` take at least `minor`. So the declaration is false as shipped.
   - **Disposition: the factory stays internal.** Nothing outside `packages/spec` needs it: its only callers are `TemplateExpressionInputSchema` and the notify config. A published factory with no consumer is surface the startup-focus axis keeps closed, and triage graded the card as wording only (`patch`).
   - **Route:** move the factory (and the helpers it needs) into a `packages/spec/src/shared/` module that `shared/index.ts` does not re-export, as `refinement-projection.ts` already is (`NON_BLANK_STRING` is absent from `api-surface/shared.json`). `expression.zod.ts` and `automation/io-node-config.zod.ts` import it from there.
   - **Acceptance:** `packages/spec/api-surface/**` and `packages/spec/export-origins/**` byte-identical to the merge base (the PR touches neither), `check:generated` green, and the dogfood census roster still discovers the notify slots (adapt the roster to the internal module).
   - Remove the changeset's "New export" bullet and the reference page's mention, and keep `Clause-②: no` / `patch`. ⛔ If keeping it internal proves structurally impossible, stop and report with the measurement. ⛔ Do not switch to `Clause-②: yes` on your own: the claim's line is the enqueue gate's input.

**Accepted as reported (no change asked):**
- The two test-only files beyond the claimed surface (`packages/lint/src/lint-flow-patterns.test.ts`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.test.ts`), each with its stated reason.
- The control pins taken at `PromptTemplate.user` and `titleFormat`.
- The model-free commit trailers.

**Out-of-scope findings:**
- `check-doc-formula-expressions.mjs` `EXPRESSION_SLOT_TYPES` not naming the factory (dormant: the notify slots carry no `@example`): Acceptance notes. Whether it stays dormant is re-read after the move.
- The `service-automation` `notify-node.ts` comment naming `TemplateExpressionInputSchema`: Acceptance notes. The input is identical and only the sentences differ, so the comment is not false. It is outside `domain:spec`.

**After the push:** the seat's ACCEPT, then the contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The diff touches `packages/spec/src/**` non-test, so the path limb is owed a record whatever the claim line says. Landing follows both.

## ✅ ACCEPT: PR #22124 at `681d77223e` (REWORK round 1 delivered). Parked for the contract review

`domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `os-justin` · session `session_01RPo7FUd6bSnAfkWMAKi848` · 2026-10-07T22:34Z · holder of claim `6044705682`, on the dev report `6048233920`.

**The REWORK's one ask is met, read on GitHub, not from the report:**
- The constructor now lives in `packages/spec/src/shared/typed-expression-input.ts` (new). `shared/index.ts` at the head still re-exports only `./expression.zod`, not this module.
- The PR's file list holds no `packages/spec/api-surface/**` or `export-origins/**` path. So the published names are those of the merge base `54ace18c6`.
- `Clause-②: no` and `patch` now hold as written.

**The changeset, read sentence by sentence against the diff:**
- "Every value that parsed still parses, every value that was refused is still refused, with the same `invalid_union` code at the same path": consistent with the diff (`typed-expression-input.ts` takes the same two arms; only the `refusals` argument differs).

- "No export is added, removed or renamed, and no type changes": consistent with the absent api-surface diff.

**Accepted deviations:**
- The constructor is two concrete functions (`cronExpressionInput`, `templateExpressionInput`), not one generic: a generic one fails `tsc` (TS2322).
- The cycle is avoided by importing `ExpressionSchema` type-only and passing it in.
- The two round-0 test-only files stay, accepted in round 0.

- The relay stored the PR body without an attribution footer, and the body names its session in prose. No gate reads it.
- The CI tally on this head when read: 42 check runs, 38 `success` and 4 `skipped`. `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` are `success` on `681d77223e`. The `Vercel` commit status is still `pending`.
